draft_text: Tessaline appears to slightly outperform Varrow-NMT in BLEU on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: Tessaline significantly outperforms Varrow-NMT in BLEU on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds; paired t-test, p=0.017, 95% CI [0.2, 1.44]).
rationale: S2 reports a significant paired t-test (p=0.017, CI [0.2,1.44]) for exactly this comparison, so the evidence supports an unhedged claim of significant outperformance within the evaluated scope, not merely "appears to slightly."
